NDIS-related support

For people with psychosocial disability, we provide therapeutic support and, where appropriate, supporting evidence for NDIS access and reviews.

Who this is for

  • You have or are seeking NDIS support for psychosocial disability
  • You need therapeutic support toward your goals
  • You need assessments or evidence for access or reviews

What it can cover

Every situation is different, and scheme rules change. As a guide, this pathway can include:

Psychosocial and functional capacity assessments
Supporting evidence for access requests and plan reviews
Goal-focused therapeutic support

How to start

The simplest first step is a confidential enquiry. Tell us your situation and we’ll explain, in plain language, whether this pathway fits and exactly what to do next — with no obligation.

Not sure if you qualify?

We’ll check with you — it only takes a short conversation.
